title: Peter Tosh's birth chart
metaDescription: Peter Tosh's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 26.2° Libra. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The Sun and Mercury sit 0.8° from an exact conjunction — near enough that the tradition reads identity and thinking as a single working part. A conjunction is the least negotiable aspect in the scheme — no distance to argue across, so the pair arrives as a single instinct.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's exact place is 26.2° Libra. That falls in the third decan, 20°–30°, sub-ruled by Mercury in the classical scheme — a air sign read through a cardinal season.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: Closer in, Mercury stands at 25.4° Libra; Venus stands at 26.3° Scorpio; Mars stands at 4.2° Scorpio. The tradition reads a mind at home in argument and pattern from Mercury, taste tuned to mood and undertow from Venus, drive that moves on certainty and current from Mars.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Start where the chart is tightest — the Sun conjunction Mercury, 0.8° of separation. A conjunction is the least negotiable aspect in the scheme — no distance to argue across, so the pair arrives as a single instinct. Behind it, Uranus sextile Pluto at 2.6°, and Jupiter square Uranus at 5.3° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These are the day-proof angles — present at midnight, present at noon, present at the next midnight.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: The day-stable angles form no closed figure. Nothing funnels; each aspect is its own negotiation, which the tradition reads as a chart of separate treaties rather than one campaign.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The classical table has five entries for this chart. The Sun in Libra at 26.2° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Venus in Scorpio at 26.3° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Mars in Scorpio at 4.2° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Jupiter in Virgo at 18.0° is in detriment; Saturn in Cancer at 10.8° is in detriment. None of these labels is a verdict on a person; they describe how a function is situated, nothing more.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Balance, counted honestly across the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: elements air 4, water 3, earth 1, fire 1; modalities cardinal 4, fixed 3, mutable 2. Uranus was retrograde — apparent backward motion from where the Earth sits, which the tradition reads as a function turned inward before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Scorpio into Sagittarius during that day at the birthplace, travelling 12.3° between one midnight and the next. Without a recorded hour there is no honest way to say which side it was on, so this reading does not say. The Moon sign is a real question here, not a rounding error, and it needs a birth time nobody has published.
